description: Hand-verified corrections for OpenAlex records that are wrong upstream. Each entry records only fields verifiable from the work's own OpenAlex record or its title. Citation counts are never replaced because no verified replacement value exists; a count proven to belong to another work is instead marked cited_by_count_unreliable, which ranks, sorts and filters the record as if it had no citations while the card keeps the published number and shows citation_count_unreliable.

W2626778328.note: Canonical Transformer paper. created_date 2017-06-23 and counts_by_year starting 2017 prove the record predates its claimed 2025 date; upstream primary_location was overwritten by a 10.65215 predatory mirror whose DOI and PDF both 404. Values below are taken from the record's own surviving arXiv locations and biblio (NeurIPS vol 30, pp 5998-6008).

W1945524409.note: Erikson, Childhood and Society (1950). Upstream publication_year 2026 is a Zenodo deposit date; citations predate it by 14 years.

W2008942963.note: Dewey, Art as Experience (1934). The record's own title carries the correct year while publication_year says 2026.
